_meta.title: Horizon picks v2 - every game in the 3-day pick window
_meta.status_note: no strategy has passed the validation gates in this repository, so every pick below is MODEL OUTPUT - UNVALIDATED with zero stake. The gate results are published so a reviewer can see exactly what each pick cleared and what it did not.

gates.note: a pick must survive every gate to be published as a stakeable pick. No strategy has passed the strategy validation gates in this repository, so every pick below is published as MODEL OUTPUT - UNVALIDATED with zero stake, which is the honest state of the evidence.

home_court_anchor.primary_measurement: the official standings HOME/ROAD columns (the largest official sample); the final-score corpus measurement is published beside it as a cross-check

standings_measurement.measured_from: the official standings HOME and ROAD columns, summed across all 30 teams

final_scores_measurement.finality_rule: is_verified_final: both scores printed, not a 0-0 placeholder, and game_status (when the capture carries one) equal to 3 = Final

home_court_anchor.sigma_margin_source: population standard deviation of the home margin on the 196 verified official finals (neutral games excluded); unplayed 0-0 placeholder rows are not in this denominator
home_court_anchor.formula: HCA_points = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(measured home win rate). The number of points is read off the measurement; nothing about it is fitted.
home_court_anchor.status: MEASURED - the home-court advantage is pinned to the official home win rate
